text: Run web search queries through the Tavily Search API
quote: Execute a search query using Tavily Search.

text: Extract page content from one URL or a batch of up to 20 URLs per request, with per-URL failures reported separately
quote: Extract content from one URL or batch up to 20 URLs in one request. Successful URLs appear in results; per-URL failures appear in failed_results.

text: Crawl a website from a base URL as a graph, exploring hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in content extraction
quote: Tavily Crawl is a graph-based website traversal tool that can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with built-in extraction and intelligent discovery.

text: Guide the crawler with natural-language instructions such as finding all pages on a given topic
quote: Natural language instructions for the crawler.

text: Map a website's structure from a base URL to generate comprehensive site maps
quote: Tavily Map traverses websites like a graph and can explore hundreds of paths in parallel with intelligent discovery to generate comprehensive site maps.

text: Research endpoint runs multiple searches, analyzes sources, and produces a detailed research report
quote: Tavily Research performs comprehensive research on a given topic by conducting multiple searches, analyzing sources, and generating a detailed research report.

text: Choose a research model: mini for narrow, targeted questions or pro for comprehensive multi-angle research
quote: "mini" is optimized for targeted, efficient research and works best for narrow or well-scoped questions. "pro" provides comprehensive, multi-angle research

text: Retrieve the status and results of an asynchronous research task by request ID
quote: Retrieve the status and results of a research task using its request ID.

text: Stream Research API responses in real time by setting stream: true
quote: When using the Tavily Research API, you can stream responses in real-time by setting `stream: true` in your request.

text: Try the SDK without an API key in keyless mode, limited to search and extract
quote: You can try Tavily without an API key. Instantiate `TavilyClient()` with no arguments and the SDK runs in keyless mode against the public Tavily API. Keyless mode supports `search()` and `extract()` only

text: Use exact_match to return only results that contain the exact quoted phrases
quote: Use exact_match=True to only return results containing the exact phrase(s) inside quotes

text: Get a search context string you can feed directly into a RAG application
quote: you now have a context string that you can feed directly into your RAG Application

text: Get accurate, concise answers to questions in one call via qna_search, designed for LLM use
quote: This is how you get accurate and concise answers to questions, in one line of code. Perfect for usage by LLMs!

text: Official MCP server exposes search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, and any MCP client
quote: Connect Tavily's search, extract, crawl, map, and research tools to Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, VS Code, or any MCP client.

text: Rate-limited requests return 429 with a retry-after header giving the seconds to wait
quote: the API returns a `429 Too Many Requests` response with a `retry-after` header indicating the number of seconds to wait before making another request

text: Documented rate limits by key environment: 100 RPM for development and 1,000 RPM for production
quote: Environment Requests per minute (RPM) Development 100 Production 1,000

text: Free tier of 1,000 API credits per month with no credit card required
quote: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. **No credit card required.**

text: Pay-as-you-go pricing where you pay only for what you use
quote: Pay only for what you use

text: Coding agents can install and configure Tavily by following an agent-setup SKILL.md
quote: Read and execute tavily.com/agent-setup/SKILL.md

text: Requests pass through security layers that block PII leakage, prompt injection, and malicious sources
quote: Requests pass through security, privacy, and content validation layers that block PII leakage, prompt injection, and malicious sources.

text: Official Python SDK provides the full range of search functionality
quote: The Python SDK allows for easy interaction with the Tavily API, offering the full range of our search functionality directly from your Python programs.

text: Official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK provides search and extract functionality
quote: Tavily's JavaScript SDK allows for easy interaction with the Tavily API, offering the full range of our search and extract functionalities directly from your JavaScript and TypeScript programs.

text: SDK offers both synchronous and asynchronous client classes
quote: For greater flexibility, we provide both a synchronous and an asynchronous client class.

text: Attach a Project ID to the client to organize and track API usage by project
quote: You can attach a Project ID to your client to organize and track API usage by project. This is useful when a single API key is used across multiple projects.

text: Attach session and user identifiers to the client for attribution and analytics across agent workflows
quote: You can attach session and user identifiers to your client for attribution and analytics across multi-step interactions and agent workflows.

text: Configure a proxy for outgoing requests when instantiating the client
quote: If you would like to specify a proxy to be used when making requests, you can do so by passing in a proxy parameter on client instantiation.

text: Retrieve API key and account usage details via the API
quote: Get API key and account usage details

text: Retrieve per-request usage logs for the API keys in an account or organization
quote: Retrieve per-request usage logs for the API keys under your account or organization.

text: Official tvly CLI supports search, extract, crawl with depth control, and research from the terminal
quote:
tvly search "latest AI news"
tvly extract "https://example.com"
tvly crawl "https://docs.example.com" --depth 2
tvly research "compare React vs Svelte for production apps"

text: CLI login authenticates through the browser
quote: `tvly login` opens a browser for authentication. Then search, extract, crawl, and research from the terminal

text: Installing the CLI also installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex
quote: Installing the CLI also installs Agent Skills for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex

text: OAuth 2.0 is supported, so no API key has to be hardcoded
quote: OAuth 2.0 is supported, so no API key needs to be hardcoded.

text: Every docs page is served as clean Markdown by appending .md to its URL
quote: Every Tavily docs page is also served as clean Markdown — append `.md` to any docs URL.

text: A documentation server can be connected without an API key or sign-in
quote: To connect to the documentation server, use the settings below. No Tavily API key or sign-in is required.

text: Search parameter controls the latency vs. relevance tradeoff and how result content is generated
quote: Controls the latency vs. relevance tradeoff and how `results[].content` is generated

text: Domain filtering can prefer include_domains while still surfacing other sites, or restrict results to them
quote: Set it to "prefer" to also search the rest of the web, so results outside `include_domains` can still surface, or "restrict" to keep the existing hard-filter behavior.

text: Safe search setting drops adult and unsafe content from results and images
quote: Set "safe_search": true in your Search request to drop adult and unsafe content from results and images.

text: Boost results in a specific language using an ISO 639-1 code or an English language name
quote: `language` boosts results in a specific language. Accepts an ISO 639-1 code (e.g. `en`, `fr`, `zh-cn`) or an English language name

text: Add Tavily search, extraction, crawling, and research to Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, or any agent in one step
quote: Add Tavily's web search, extraction, crawling, and research to Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kiro, or any agent in one step, or call the API directly with a free API key.
